steps.text: Search the member by name. Here we pick a member with no active meter, because a member tied to an active meter cannot be deactivated.
steps.title: Find the member

steps.text: Click the member's row in the table to open their record.
steps.title: Open the member record

steps.text: Tap the member's card to open their record.
steps.title: Open the member record

steps.text: The member is active: its status badge is green and a "Meter" tab is available. The action buttons let you deactivate it or put it on hold.
steps.title: Active member record

steps.text: Click "Deactivate". The status change is immediate, with no extra confirmation.
steps.title: Deactivate the member

steps.text: The badge switches to "Inactive" and the "Meter" tab disappears: an inactive member can no longer be tied to a meter.
steps.title: Member deactivated

steps.text: The "Activate" button reactivates the member. You can manage a member's whole lifecycle from its record.
steps.title: Reactivate the member

steps.text: The badge returns to "Active" and the "Meter" tab reappears. The member is fully operational again.
steps.title: Member reactivated
